descriptions.zh:
对于调用MaskOssImage，且IsAlwaysUpload为ture的文件来说，可以通过RestoreOssImage来获取原图片。

例如，Bucket中的图片aliyun_dsc_desensitization/exampledir/test.png，复原后会存储为aliyun_dsc_original/exampledir/test.png。
descriptions.en:
For files that were masked by calling MaskOssImage with IsAlwaysUpload set to true, you can call RestoreOssImage to retrieve the original image.

For example, the image aliyun_dsc_desensitization/exampledir/test.png in the bucket is stored as aliyun_dsc_original/exampledir/test.png after restoration.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp restore-oss-image --bucket test-sddp --object-key aliyun_dsc_desensitization/dir1/test.png --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-object-key aliyun_dsc_original_/dir1/test.png --region cn-hangzhou
